title: Crop Decision Command Centre & Agronomic Planning
based_on: AGROLATTICE 11.10 — Climate & Earth Observation Command Centre
database_migration: No protected database migration. One additive independent models_evidence/crop_profiles.sqlite registry is introduced at schema 1.0.0.
performance_guards: No automatic NASA retrieval on Crop Decisions entry
No automatic pest model inference/training on Crop Decisions entry
No automatic nutrient or irrigation optimisation on Crop Decisions entry
No automatic AquaCrop/DSSAT/APSIM execution on Crop Decisions entry
Persisted field/Twin evidence reused before optional retrieval
Large country climate runtime cache retained from Release 11.6
limitations: Historical sowing-date output is climate-exposure screening rather than an official sowing calendar or cultivar-specific yield optimiser.
Operational pest inference is restricted to explicitly eligible registered model artifacts and reproducible predictors.
Crop-model execution does not by itself establish local calibration, cross-site validation or decision benefit.
Recorded operation costs are starting evidence and may not represent complete farm accounting.
Full interactive Streamlit browser testing requires the user's installed Windows/Anaconda environment.
